what_was_published: recorded as an orchestration failure with stops: []
conclusion: The arm was killed by the kernel OOM reaper, not stopped by the runtime. T2_MEMORY_FLOOR is reactive (250 ms period), so an OOM can beat it between checks; the 32 MiB floor therefore does not prevent kernel OOM, it only reports a later refusal.
effect_on_the_tap_measurement: none - the chain in that arm saw no game because it ran before the arm; the tap length is still unmeasured at 550 ms
